text: [Zohm](/lore/zohm/) is the energy of everything, flowing upward from the world's core.
The more widely a [Name](/lore/names/) is recognised, the more [Zohm](/lore/zohm/) its subject may attract.
[True Life](/lore/true-life/) alone holds the natural balance between [Order and Chaos](/lore/true-life/#order-and-chaos).
“A child will wake speaking no language their mother knows.”
author: Unknown

text: [The Beneath](/location/the-beneath/) began as a myth before the [First Great Pulse](/lore/great-pulse/#the-first-great-pulse) made it real.
[Zohm](/lore/zohm/) is more abundant in [The Beneath](/location/the-beneath/), making its objects stronger and its depths far more dangerous.
The [Golden Wastes](/location/the-wastes/) earned their name from their strange abundance of gold and other rare materials.
[Snaggleteeth](/location/snaggleteeth/) is scarred by enormous black spires and craters said to reach [the Beneath](/location/the-beneath/).
[Ghar's Throat](/location/ghars-throat/) is a colossal ancient stairway that can take days to descend.
[Spire](/location/spire/) survives beneath a giant stone formation that provides shade, high ground and a natural wall.
Some cogs buried in [Mech Wreck](/location/mech-wreck/) are large enough to rival entire hills.
[Copperhelm](/location/copperhelm/) survives among enormous ruined buildings crowned by smooth metallic roofs.
[Spikewood](/lore/spikewood/) can appear dead for years while surviving extreme heat and cold.
[Choppers](/item/chopper/) are massive two-handed blades forged from reclaimed copper and bronze relics.
A [Glob](/monster/glob/) can turn its soft body into a dense metal-like projectile without warning.
[Bonestalkers](/monster/bonestalker/) navigate violent storms without sight, relying on sound and vibration.

Match materials to purpose: [Wood](/lore/elements/#wood-north) adapts, [Glass](/lore/elements/#glass-east) reveals, [Stone](/lore/elements/#stone-west) endures and [Metal](/lore/elements/#metal-south) strengthens.
“The world does not choose which memories deserve to survive.”
author: Tablet translation

text: [Oru's](/lore/oru/) [Name](/lore/names/) survived the [Memory Plagues](/lore/memory-plague/) even as generations of history disappeared.
A [Great Pulse](/lore/great-pulse/) floods the world with [Zohm](/lore/zohm/) to wash away accumulated [Fell Names](/lore/names/#fell-names).
